resources.string: Shown while FamilyGuard is actively enforcing screen-time rules on this device.

FamilyGuard parental controls. When active, this device is marked as \"Parental controls active\" and uninstalling FamilyGuard or clearing its data is blocked while this is on. You can turn this off any time in Settings > Apps > Special access > Device admin apps — doing so allows uninstall and notifies your parent.
Turning this off stops parental controls on this device and your parent gets notified. FamilyGuard can then be uninstalled.
Device admin is off — uninstall is no longer blocked and your parent has been notified.
